preprocessing.missing_value_handling: Checked; no missing values were found in the supplied dataset.
preprocessing.duplicate_handling: Checked; no duplicate rows were found in the supplied dataset.
preprocessing.gradient_boosting_transform: Raw numeric predictors are passed to the tree ensemble; no scaling or one-hot encoding is applied.

steps: Check missing values and duplicate rows.
Create an 80/20 stratified train/test split with random seed 42.
Keep the held-out test set untouched during Gradient Boosting tuning.
Pass raw numeric predictors to the tree-based models.

model.name: Tuned Gradient Boosting
model.concept_note: Tree structure metadata is from the fitted ensemble. The sequential correction arrows in the UI are a conceptual explanation; this artifact does not claim a simplified tree score is the estimator's exact internal score.

explainability.method: Exact tree-path additive decomposition of the fitted Gradient Boosting decision score.
explainability.scale: raw decision-score / log-odds scale, before the sigmoid probability transform
explainability.identity: For every exported record: decision_score = baseline_score + sum(feature_contributions). The baseline includes the fitted initial raw score and tree-root corrections.
explainability.note: A contribution shows how the fitted model's tree paths moved its decision score for this record. It is model behavior, not causation.
